notes:
POC-heavy enterprise. Primary pain: retrieval precision on noisy clinical notes + PHI controls. Wants embeddings + rerank pipeline: dense vectors at scale + cheap lightweight reranker for recall boost. Key quotes: 'Need sub-200ms median end-to-end for clinician-facing search' and 'absolute must: full audit trail per token/request and customer-managed keys.'

Shorthand impressions:
- Data: ~120M docs (notes, discharge summaries, scanned PDFs OCRed -> noisy), expect growth 30%/yr
- Latency target: 150-200ms median for search-serving path (embeddings lookup + topK rerank). P99 can be higher but want SLO guidance
- Throughput: 200 qps baseline, occasional bursts to 1k qps during rounds
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high; willing to pay for dedicated predictability but wants clear $/query modeling; target effective cost per search <= $0.03 (emb + rerank amortized) for baseline workload
- Model prefs: embeddings: open 2K-8K dim (FAISS/HNSW) + L2/inner product; re-ranker: smaller cross-encoder (2-4B) or distilled models; fallback to 7B causal for complex multi-hop answers
- Routing: geo-aware (NA primary), failover to another region; dataset residency required for PHI
- Logging: immutable audit logs, user-level access logs, retention tunable to 7 yrs; must support SIEM integration (Splunk, SumoLogic)
use_case_summary: Clinical documentation search for frontline clinicians and research cohort discovery. Precision critical: reduce irrelevant hits, surface most clinically relevant paragraphs. Combine dense retrieval + lightweight reranker to balance latency and quality. Integrate with EHR, FHIR store, and enterprise SSO. Strict PHI controls and customer-managed keys.
requirements_summary: Index scale: initial 120M documents, expect near-term growth -> design for 200M+ capacity
Throughput: sustained 200 qps, burst to 1k qps; autoscaling for spikes
Cost: target <= $0.03/query (amortized across embeddings + reranker), willingness to trade some cost for dedicated capacity guarantees
Security: VPC/private deployment, customer-managed KMS/HSM, SOC2/ISO27001, SSO/SAML, per-request immutable audit logs
Data residency: all PHI to remain in NA region; support for on-prem connector for full air-gap option
Observability: per-token latency and cost breakdown, per-route dashboards, alerting on embedding drift/regression
